item.title: Troubleshooting the Engineer's Brain
item.description: The engineering mindset is fantastic at finding edge cases and hunting bugs. However, it often turns these same powers against you. Let’s look at how an engineer’s mindset can have too many unhandled exceptions. Common Brain Bugs and Their Fixes CODE REVIEW DEFENSIVENESS Scenario: You receive several comments on your pull request and immediately feel a wave of shame and defensiveness. Bug: Personalizing and catastrophizing—you treat feedback about your code as criticism of your worth and abilities.
